list.title: Workspaces
list.search: Search by name, slug, id or a member's email
list.noMatchHint: Try another name, slug, id or member email, or clear the filters.
list.emptyHint: Workspaces show up here as people sign up and create them.

restore.title: Restore this workspace?
restore.text: {{name}} works again for its members, API keys, widget and help center. Mail ignored while it was suspended is not replayed.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.description: Members, API keys, the widget and the help center stop working, inbound mail is stored and ignored, and nothing is sent. Nothing is deleted.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: Every ticket, contact, article, mailbox and setting of this workspace is removed for good, and its Stripe subscription is canceled. This can't be undone.

detail.suspendedHint: Members can sign in and see it, but nothing runs for it until it is restored.

test.outOfCounts: It stays out of the overview's counts.

mailboxes.title: Mailboxes
mailboxes.emptyHint: This workspace hasn't connected a mailbox.

limits.title: Plan and limits
limits.noBilling: Billing is off on this instance, so every limit is unlimited. Overrides are kept but have no effect.

sub.billingOff: Billing is off on this instance.

grant.title: Grant AI usage
grant.description: Adds purchased AI usage to {{name}}. It is spent after the monthly allowance, like a top-up, and never expires.
grant.notePlaceholder: Why, and any ticket it relates to

audit.title: Workspace audit log
audit.emptyHint: Changes to settings, members and keys appear here.

limitsDialog.title: Limit overrides
limitsDialog.description: Overrides replace the plan's limits for {{name}} on every plan, and survive plan changes.
limitsDialog.noBilling: Billing is off on this instance, so every limit is already unlimited. Overrides are kept but have no effect.

monthly_ai_usd.label: Monthly AI allowance
monthly_ai_usd.hint: US dollars of AI usage included each month.

collab_storage_gb.label: Collab storage
collab_storage_gb.hint: Mail Collab stores for the whole workspace. 0 is unlimited.

collab.title: Collab
collab.hintBilling: The Collab plan is hidden. Offer it so this workspace can subscribe at $38 per user per month, or give it for free.
collab.hintNoBilling: Billing is off on this instance, so every workspace has Collab unless the instance turns it off. Access is kept but has no effect.
collab.noBilling: Billing is off on this instance, so this is kept but has no effect.

offer.title: Offer the Collab plan
offer.description: {{name}} sees the Collab plan on its billing page and can subscribe at $38 per user per month, or switch its Pro subscription to it.

free.title: Give Collab for free
free.description_one: {{name}} gets the Collab plan without paying: unlimited mailboxes and members, $20 of AI per paid seat each month ({{n}} seat now), and Collab.
free.description_other: {{name}} gets the Collab plan without paying: unlimited mailboxes and members, $20 of AI per paid seat each month ({{n}} seats now), and Collab.

remove.title: Remove Collab access?
remove.complimentary: {{name}} loses Collab now unless it pays for the plan. Connected mail accounts stop syncing and are kept.
remove.offered: {{name}} can no longer subscribe to the Collab plan. A subscription it already has keeps running.

collab.lastDayHint: Access ends at the end of this day, your time.

dateError.past: Pick a day in the future.
